samples.summary: rest-api.md — the canonical enumeration of every `/api/v1` route — is not updated for the ~15 endpoints this change adds. Missing: the whole comments surface (`GET/POST .../comments`, `POST :threadId/replies`, `PATCH :threadId`, `PATCH :threadId/comments/:commentId`, `DELETE` x2), the slides verbs (`GET .../layouts`, `POST .../slides`, `.../slides/:id/duplicate|move`, `DELETE .../slides/:id`), the new tab verbs (`DELETE .../tabs/:tid`, `POST .../tabs/:tid/reorder`, `POST .../tabs/:tid/duplicate`), `GET/PUT .../tabs/:tid/images`, and board support in §5.5 (which still says the content routes serve only doc/slides/note). §6 Module Structure likewise omits the four new controllers. CONTRIBUTING requires updating the existing design doc for a non-trivial change; the reorder-vs-move naming collision documented in `tabs.controller.ts` is exactly the kind of contract a reader of §5.4 needs recorded.
searchedFor: grep for comments/slides/board endpoints in docs/design

samples.summary: cli.md's §4 Command Tree and the safety table (~line 1594) are not updated for the new commands: `board content|set-content`, the whole `comments` namespace, `sheets images get|set`, `sheets tabs delete|move|duplicate`, `slides layouts` and `slides slide add|duplicate|move|delete`. The tree is exhaustive for every other namespace (including the class-A commands added earlier), so it now under-reports the CLI it documents, and the destructive `sheets images set` / `comments delete*` entries are absent from the safety table that records exactly that classification.
searchedFor: grep set-content|sheets charts|folders list in cli.md

samples.summary: The class-B table (Comments 6 / Slide granular editing 5 / Tab rearrange 3 / Sheet floating images 2 / Board 2) is the audit this change closes, yet it carries no status note — while classes A and A′ each got one (lines 141-151, 166-172) for precisely this situation, explaining that the table is left as measured but the gap is closed. Without it the roadmap still reads as if 18 items are unreachable, and 'Reading the totals' still claims 'Fill in the missing commands covers roughly 37'.

The mention grammar moved from `packages/frontend/src/components/comments/mentions.ts` to `@wafflebase/sheets` `comment/mentions.ts`, but comments-mentions.md — the canonical doc for that module — still heads its section 'New shared helper — packages/frontend/src/components/comments/mentions.ts' and describes the helpers as frontend-owned (lines 87, 102-108, 152, 222). The move is recorded only in notifications.md, i.e. in a second doc rather than folded into the owning one; the top-level backtick-path check still passes because the frontend file survives as a re-export, so nothing mechanical will catch the staleness.

board.md's 'Data model & Yorkie store' section documents `YorkieBoardRoot` as living only in `packages/frontend/src/types/board-document.ts`, and its Backend wiring checklist (lines 360-366) lists three touch points, none of which is content read/write. This change adds a second authoritative board root shape (`packages/backend/src/yorkie/board-tree.ts`) plus REST read/write of board content; the owning design doc records neither.

The new `PATCH .../comments/:threadId/comments/:commentId` (edit a comment) endpoint has no CLI command, no `HttpClient` method and no `schema/registry.ts` entry, while every other comment verb got all three. That leaves a freshly-added endpoint reachable only by hand-rolled HTTP — the exact class-A shape ('endpoint exists, no way to call it from a terminal') this work exists to eliminate, and an agent asked to fix a typo in its own comment must delete and re-post instead.

`applySlideChange`'s `move` branch re-implements the CRDT reorder math already in `packages/frontend/src/app/slides/yorkie-slides-store.ts#moveSlide` (lines 818-839): same clamp, same `moveFront` head case, same `moveAfterByIndex(to, from)` / `moveAfterByIndex(to - 1, from)` ±1 split. Everything else in this module reuses `MemSlidesStore`, so this is the one rule stated twice; if either off-by-one is ever corrected, an API move and an editor move place the same slide at different positions.

`toYorkieMs`/`fromYorkieMs`/`copyAuthor`/`copyComment`/`copyThread` are a third statement of the copy-and-Long-conversion layer already written in `packages/frontend/src/app/files/comments/pdf-comment-store.ts` (lines 22-85) and the docs Yorkie comment store. The change proved the alternative works in this same diff by moving the mention grammar and the notification planner into `@wafflebase/sheets` beside `comment/thread.ts`; this layer is equally engine-agnostic and equally shared between the two writers, and a divergence in the Long boundary is exactly the '1970 date' bug its own comments warn about.

`BoardDocument`/`BoardMeta` (`{ meta: { title, unit?, recentColors? }, elements }`) is a third declaration of a shape already exported as `BoardModel` from `@wafflebase/board` (`packages/board/src/model/board.ts:22`) and as `YorkieBoardRoot` in the frontend. The backend does not yet depend on `@wafflebase/board` (it depends on sheets/docs/slides), so reuse would cost a workspace dependency — but the repo's stated expectation is reuse, and this is now the canonical wire shape for the board content endpoint declared away from the package that owns the model.

`getImages` answers `{ images: [] }` for a tab that does not exist while `setImages` 404s on the same tab id, so a caller cannot distinguish 'tab with no images' from 'no such tab' on the read half. Every other tab-scoped read on this surface resolves the tab; the asymmetry is deliberate per the spec comment but is worth stating in the API doc rather than only in a test name.
